newsitem.title: USA: ACTV receives rest of private placement.
newsitem.headline: ACTV receives rest of private placement.

text.p: ACTV Inc said Wednesday the final $6 million of a previously announced $10 million private placement has been released to the company.
The release of the funds from the sale of convertible preferred stock in August was contingent on signing of a commercial contract with FOX Sports Net, an ACTV spokesman explained.
The company said FOX Sports Net is the domestic telecasting arm of the worldwide sports alliance recently formed between News Corp, Liberty Media Corp and Tele-Communications Inc.
The company said the funds will be targeted to support the initial launch of regional premium digital networks anchored by programming from FOX Sports Net.

Under terms of an agreement reached in late December, ACTV said, it has the right through June 30, 2003, to offer enhanced FOX Sports Net programming to any distributor carrying the regionalized FOX Sports channel.
In each region, ACTV and FOX Sports Net will work together in developing innovative sports programming, which will be the basis for new and differentiated programming services.

ACTV and FOX Sports West have been evaluating enhanced sporting events in Southern California for the past year and a half, clearly demonstrating that sports viewers see significant added value for ACTV's brand of individualized programming when combined with the enormous versatility of West's offerings, the company said.
Equally important, over 80 percent of viewers expressed increased satisfaction with TCI of Ventura County directly attributable to the operator's carriage of ACTV's individualized programming.
FOX Sports consists of seven owned and operated regional sports affiliates from coast-to-coast.
